acceptanceCriteria: The integrity gate dynamically discovers active and archived Work Items without a hard-coded WI range.
The gate emits an auditable JSON receipt with deterministic findings and fails closed on an unregistered broken link.
Historical or legacy records are explicitly classified and do not masquerade as current release failures.
Regression fixtures cover missing Work Item, missing evidence, missing close, historical exemption, unknown problem, foreign receipt, and spoofed default-branch cases.
Documentation parity and workflow/release/conformance/performance gates are invoked in CI without duplicate conflicting execution.
Workspace package test coverage is derived from cargo metadata and fails when a package is omitted.
Only tests, docs, GitHub workflow files, and Runtime-generated WI-188/WI-192 lifecycle records are changed; no crates are changed.
The compatibility finding for installed Runtime v0.2.23 finish ordering is preserved and the successor runs finalize-plan before preflight, checkpoint, verify, finish, and archive.
goal: Bind exact PR resource context before preflight and reverify the completed WI-188 governance integrity implementation without changing its product scope.
intent: Recover WI-188 after the installed v0.2.23 Runtime accepted finish before a non-provisional finalization plan; preserve the predecessor facts and deliver the same authorized governance integrity gate through the strict lifecycle order.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A newly introduced Work Item is discovered without editing an ID list.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the gate against a fixture containing an additional WI id and assert the generated inventory includes it.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing evidence, close, foreign receipt, or spoofed default-branch linkage produces a deterministic failed finding.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run all governance-integrity negative fixtures and assert non-zero exit plus exact JSON findings.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Historical ambiguity is auditable but does not become a current release failure.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the historical duplicate fixture and assert warnings without blocking findings.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Every workspace package and every discovered repository gate is covered exactly once.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare cargo metadata package names and recursively discovered gate scripts against deterministic receipts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The successor binds a non-provisional finalization plan before preflight and verification while preserving WI-188 finish_ready facts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Record finalize-plan against the exact draft PR before preflight, then execute checkpoint and single-worker Runtime verification.
